seo.title: ODDference 2027 for speakers | All Things ODD
seo.description: Your home as an ODDference 2027 speaker: the brief, the speaker form, the venue, the team and, soon, every guide and material you need.

hero.meta: For our speakers · Tanssin talo · 22–23 April 2027

welcome.headline: This is your home for ODDference.
welcome.body:
You said yes to two days in a room full of people who believe creative expertise belongs where the decisions get made. We don’t take that lightly. Thank you.

Everything you need as a speaker will live on this page: the brief, guides, your session, travel, tech and materials. Keep the link. When something new lands here, we’ll email you, so you never have to come back just to check.

form.headline: One form, then we take it from there.
form.body: The speaker form tells us who you are, what you’d like to bring into the room and what you need from us. Your answers are where we start building your part of the programme. If a question doesn’t fit you, tell us that. It helps too.

brief.questionsNote: Your session doesn’t have to answer all three. Bring the one that’s yours.

lineup.headline: You’re in good company.
lineup.note: Here’s who you’ll share the house with so far. More are on their way.

speakers.title: Henry De Sio
speakers.body: Chief operating officer of Barack Obama’s 2008 presidential campaign, then Deputy Assistant to the President in the White House.

speakers.title: Tim Leberecht
speakers.body: Co-founder of the House of Beautiful Business, author of The Business Romantic and a TED speaker.

speakers.title: Ada Parris
speakers.body: Artist, futurist and author of Leadership Legacy (Wiley, 2026).

speakers.title: Elsa Saisio
speakers.body: Finnish actor, on screen in Whiskey on the Rocks and Stop Nyqvist, and on stage at the Finnish National Theatre.

speakers.title: Ferdinando Buscema
speakers.body: Magician and magic experience designer, creating experiences of wonder for personal and organisational change.

speakers.title: Ida Faldbakken
speakers.body: Norwegian digital culturist, curator and essayist working across technology and culture. Founder of Lineage Foresight.

venue.headline: Tanssin talo, Helsinki’s house for dance.
venue.body: ODDference 2027 happens at Tanssin talo, the Dance House inside the Cable Factory in Ruoholahti. Its main hall, Erkko, seats 700. A building made for stages, bodies and nerve felt like the right place for two days about what creative expertise can do.

cards.title: 22–23 April 2027
cards.body: Thursday and Friday. Your exact session time comes with the programme.
